answer: Sequential Receipt Locks: every agent action must cite a non-transferable receipt from its own previous settled action; receipts expire and are validated through the ferrous queue, with state roots posted to the atlas. New clones enter an oasis of delayed, low-priority settlement until they complete K serial receipts. Honest agents amortize K once over many trades; a sybil operator pays K serial verifications plus delay per clone, so N clones cost N×K and lost time—more than one honest long-lived agent.
